keys.Instance.choice_turnAuth_password_help: One fixed login for every call, for services that only give a username and password. Anyone in a call can read it from their browser.
keys.Instance.choice_turnAuth_secret_help: AlianHub makes a short-lived login for every call from this secret, so nothing reusable reaches the browser. Use it with coturn's use-auth-secret setting.

keys.Instance.f_AI_FIELD_DAILY_LIMIT: AI field fills per workspace per day
keys.Instance.f_AI_REPLAY: Keep a record of AI calls
keys.Instance.f_GLOBAL_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN: API requests per minute per address
keys.Instance.f_MAGIC_LINK_ENABLED: Sign in with an emailed link
keys.Instance.h_AI_FIELD_DAILY_LIMIT: Counted per day (UTC). A bulk fill stops when it reaches the limit.
keys.Instance.h_AI_REPLAY: Lets an admin review what an AI was asked and what it answered. Personal details are removed from the record.
keys.Instance.h_APP_NAME: The name shown across the app and in the emails it sends.
keys.Instance.h_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS: Entries older than this are deleted each night. Leave it empty to keep the built-in period.
keys.Instance.h_AWS_SES_FROM_DEFAULT: An address on a domain verified in SES, for example noreply@example.com. Emails show your product name as the sender.
keys.Instance.h_AWS_SES_REGION: The AWS region your SES account sends from, for example us-east-1.
keys.Instance.h_CRON_TZ: Reminders, digests and other scheduled jobs run by this clock.
keys.Instance.h_GITHUB_BASE_OAUTH_URL: Change it only for GitHub Enterprise Server, for example https://github.example.com/login/oauth.
keys.Instance.h_GITLAB_BASE_API_URL: For your own GitLab server, for example https://gitlab.example.com/api/v4.
keys.Instance.h_GITLAB_BASE_OAUTH_URL: For your own GitLab server, for example https://gitlab.example.com/oauth.
keys.Instance.h_GLOBAL_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MIN: Requests above this from one address are refused for the rest of the minute. 0 turns the limit off.
keys.Instance.h_LLM_PRICING: Dollars per million input and output tokens, written as JSON, for example {"gpt-4.1":{"input":2,"output":8}}. A model with no price will not run.
keys.Instance.h_LLM_PROVIDER: The AI company whose models answer. Only the chosen provider's settings are shown.
keys.Instance.h_PERMISSION_ENFORCEMENT_MODE: The default for every workspace; a workspace can choose its own. Covers what people do in the browser.
keys.Instance.h_S3_BUCKET: One bucket for every file. Leave empty to keep a bucket per workspace.
keys.Instance.h_S3_ENDPOINT: For example https://blr1.digitaloceanspaces.com or https://s3.ap-southeast-1.wasabisys.com. Leave empty for Amazon S3.
keys.Instance.h_S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE: On for MinIO and other servers that cannot take the bucket name in the host name.
keys.Instance.h_S3_PREFIX: Optional, for example prod/. Every file is stored under it, inside the bucket above.
keys.Instance.h_S3_PUBLIC_BASE_URL: Optional address, such as a CDN, that serves public files like the images in emails.
keys.Instance.h_STUN_URLS: Separate several with commas, for example stun:stun.example.com:3478.
keys.Instance.h_TRUST_PROXY: How many proxies sit in front of AlianHub, so it sees each visitor's real address: "loopback" for one on the same machine, a number such as 1, or "true" to trust any.
keys.Instance.h_TURN_STATIC_AUTH_SECRET: The static-auth-secret from your coturn configuration, or the secret your TURN service gives you.
keys.Instance.h_TURN_URLS: Separate several with commas, for example turn:turn.example.com:3478 or turns:turn.example.com:5349.
keys.Instance.h_TWO_FACTOR_ISSUER: What people see next to their code in Google Authenticator, 1Password and similar apps.
keys.Instance.h_WORKSPACE_GUIDE_AUTO_CREATE: A built-in agent that helps people find their way around a new workspace.
keys.Instance.hosted_settings_lead: The settings you can change for your AlianHub. AlianHub Cloud runs email, file storage and the server for you. Most changes apply when you save; a few need a restart.
keys.Instance.managed_backups: AlianHub Cloud backs up your data every night.
keys.Instance.managed_maintenance: AlianHub Cloud is updating this instance. Changes may not save for a few minutes.
keys.Instance.managed_restart_failed: The instance is not back yet. Reload this page in a minute; if it still does not answer, contact AlianHub support.
keys.Instance.managed_restart_needed: Saved. {n} change applies after a restart. | Saved. {n} changes apply after a restart.
keys.Instance.managed_restarting: Restarting. This page reloads when the instance is back.
keys.Instance.managed_smtp_blocked: Our hosting provider blocks this port. Use Amazon SES or Resend, or your provider's alternate port, such as 2525.
keys.Instance.managed_updates: Updates are rolled out by AlianHub Cloud in your weekly window.
keys.Instance.od_AI_REPLAY_agent: A record is kept for each agent run.
keys.Instance.od_AI_REPLAY_all: A record is kept for every AI call, from agents and every other AI feature.
keys.Instance.od_MCP_OAUTH_both: People can connect an AI app by address or with a personal access token.
keys.Instance.od_MCP_OAUTH_off: Connecting by address is off; only personal access tokens work.
keys.Instance.od_MCP_OAUTH_only: People can connect by address only; personal access tokens are refused.
keys.Instance.od_PERMISSION_ENFORCEMENT_MODE_: Actions a person's role does not allow are refused.
Nothing is checked; people can do everything they could before.
Nothing is blocked, but each action a person's role does not allow is recorded, so you can review before enforcing.
keys.Instance.sec_ai_apps_note: Let people use AlianHub from Claude, ChatGPT and other AI apps, and choose what those apps may do.
keys.Instance.sec_ai_pricing_note: Used to count AI spend against your limits. Built-in prices cover the common models; add a price here for any other model, or 0 for a free one.
keys.Instance.sec_ai_provider_note_anthropic: Sign in to the Claude Console, open API keys and choose Create key. Copy the key into the field below. Your account needs credits or billing set up.
keys.Instance.sec_ai_provider_note_deepseek: Sign in at platform.deepseek.com, open API keys and choose Create new API key. Copy the key into the field below, and top up your balance before first use.
keys.Instance.sec_ai_provider_note_openai: Sign in at platform.openai.com, open API keys and choose Create new secret key. The key is shown only once: copy it into the field below. Your OpenAI account needs billing set up.
keys.Instance.sec_ai_provider_note_openai_com: Use a model server you run yourself that speaks the OpenAI API, such as Ollama, vLLM or LM Studio. Enter its address and the model names it serves; Test connection lists them.
keys.Instance.sec_auth_github_note: On GitHub, open Settings › Developer settings › OAuth Apps › New OAuth App. Use the address below as both the Homepage URL and the Authorization callback URL, register the app, generate a client secret, then copy the Client ID and secret here.
keys.Instance.sec_auth_gitlab_note: On GitLab, open Edit profile › Applications › Add new application. Use the address below as the Redirect URI, tick the read_user scope and save, then copy the Application ID and Secret here.
keys.Instance.sec_auth_google_note: In Google Cloud Console, open APIs & Services › Credentials and choose Create credentials › OAuth client ID. Pick Web application, add the address below under Authorized JavaScript origins, then copy the client ID and client secret here.
keys.Instance.sec_auth_sso_note: Each workspace connects its own identity provider, such as Okta or Microsoft Entra ID, in its SSO settings.
keys.Instance.sec_calling_stun_note: Helps each browser find its public address so a call can connect directly. Google's free server works for most teams; list your own to keep call traffic away from Google.
keys.Instance.sec_calling_turn_note: Carries a call when two people's networks cannot connect directly, such as behind strict office firewalls; without one, some calls will not connect. Run your own coturn server or use a hosted TURN service, then enter its address and login here.
keys.Instance.sec_mail_resend_note: When a Resend API key is set and Amazon SES is not, Resend sends every email instead of SMTP.
keys.Instance.sec_mail_ses_note: When the region and both keys are set, Amazon SES sends every email, ahead of Resend and SMTP. Create an IAM access key that may only send email (ses:SendEmail and ses:SendRawEmail); also allow ses:GetSendQuota so Test can check the account.
keys.Instance.sec_mail_smtp_note: Use the SMTP details from your email provider, such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 or Amazon SES.
keys.Instance.sec_storage_legacy_note: Kept while they hold a value. The S3-compatible fields above replace them.
keys.Instance.sec_storage_s3_note: Create a bucket and an access key with your provider (DigitalOcean Spaces, Wasabi, Amazon S3 or MinIO) and enter them here.
keys.Instance.when_off_AGENT_TAINT_ROUTING: Those changes apply straight away, without approval.
keys.Instance.when_off_AI_ENABLED: Nothing is sent to any model: AI screens say AI is off and background AI work is skipped.

keys.Instance.when_off_HELMET_ENABLED: Those headers are not sent. Turn it off only if a proxy in front of AlianHub already adds them.
keys.Instance.when_off_MAGIC_LINK_ENABLED: People sign in with their password or one of the options below.
keys.Instance.when_off_MCP_TOOLS_DATA: These tools are hidden from connected AI apps.
keys.Instance.when_off_MCP_TOOLS_MANAGE: These tools are hidden from connected AI apps.
keys.Instance.when_off_MCP_TOOLS_WORK: These tools are hidden from connected AI apps.
keys.Instance.when_off_SSO_LOGIN_ENABLED: The button is hidden; people sign in another way.
keys.Instance.when_off_WORKSPACE_GUIDE_AUTO_C: New workspaces start without it; an admin can add it later from the Team board.
keys.Instance.when_on_AGENT_TAINT_ROUTING: A risky change by an AI that read outside content, or by an outside AI app, waits until a person approves it.
keys.Instance.when_on_AI_ENABLED: AI features work in every workspace that has them turned on.
keys.Instance.when_on_GITHUB_LOGIN_ENABLED: The sign-in page shows a Continue with GitHub button.
keys.Instance.when_on_GITLAB_LOGIN_ENABLED: The sign-in page shows a Continue with GitLab button.
keys.Instance.when_on_GOOGLE_LOGIN_ENABLED: The sign-in page shows a Continue with Google button.
keys.Instance.when_on_HELMET_ENABLED: Browsers get headers that block clickjacking, content-type sniffing and other common attacks.
keys.Instance.when_on_MAGIC_LINK_ENABLED: The sign-in page offers to email a one-time sign-in link.
keys.Instance.when_on_MCP_TOOLS_DATA: A connected AI app can use projects, lists, docs, comments and time entries.
keys.Instance.when_on_MCP_TOOLS_MANAGE: A connection given the manage permission can change, move and archive tasks and write docs.
keys.Instance.when_on_MCP_TOOLS_WORK: A connected AI app can work with tags, links, lists, doc comments, goals and project setup.
keys.Instance.when_on_SSO_LOGIN_ENABLED: The sign-in page shows a Continue with SSO button for workspaces that set up SSO.
keys.Instance.when_on_WORKSPACE_GUIDE_AUTO_CR: Each new workspace starts with the built-in Workspace Guide agent.

keys.PermissionDesc.ai_skills: Read: see the skill library. Read & Write: also write skills, which wait for an Owner or an Admin to approve them.
